card.title: RED DEVILS
card.text: It costs the enemy +1 kredits to target or attack this unit.
card.flavorText: The 508th Parachute Infantry Regiment, aka Red Devils, is an airborne unit of the US Army that was formed in 1942. After extensive training the regiment participated in Operation Overlord in 1944 as part of the 82nd Airborne Division. The regiment saw heavy fighting and their contribution was considered decisive in helping the airborne meet its objectives at Normandy. Later that same year the regiment jumped into Holland as part of Operation Market Garden, where they maintained a defensive position over 11 km long against heavy German resistance, and prevented the demolition of the Nijmegen Bridge across the Waal River. In December 1944 the regiment moved into Belgium along with the 82nd Airborne and saw extensive action in the Ardenne Forest, in what is known as the Battle of the Bulge, where they defended their positions against the German Panzer Divisions. After the Battle of the Bulge the regiment saw little combat and in 1946 it returned to the US and deactivated.
